name: midflight-verification-intent-repair-gitroot-bootstrap
title: Repair mid-flight verification intent gaps and gitRoot worktree bootstrap
description: Implement the Lattice CLI fixes described in docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-midflight-story-repair-and-gitroot-worktree-plan.md. The ClawCreek B-5a12 case showed that a story adopted mid-flight can contain complete verification evidence while still lacking checklist verificationIntent, leaving story_review unable to close the workflow. The same incident showed that INIT_CHECK worktree bootstrap must use configured gitRoot and signed workspace resolution when metadata lives in a non-git wrapper root. The previously reported sourceManifestDigest checklist_update --help issue was re-tested and is excluded unless it reproduces again.
